_hinweis: Englische Texte der Startseite (scripts/build_site.py -> /en/). Links: Deutsch wie in frontend/index.html, rechts: Englisch. Ein Test meldet fehlende Übersetzungen.

texts.Malipin – Outfits & Deko passend zu dein: Malipin – Outfits & Decor That Match Your Pinterest Style
texts.Malipin erkennt deinen Stil aus Pinteres: Malipin reads your style from your Pinterest boards or an outfit photo and finds matching fashion & home decor – new and second hand, within your budget.
texts.Malipin: Pinterest-Board wird zu passend: Malipin: a Pinterest board turns into matching outfits and decor
texts.Malipin liest deine Pinterest-Boards, er: Malipin reads your Pinterest boards, gets your style and finds matching clothes and decor from lots of shops and second hand. Sorted by your budget.
texts.Hat dir ein Fit auf TikTok oder Instagra: Loved a fit on TikTok or Instagram?
texts.Mach einen Screenshot und lad ihn hier h: Take a screenshot and upload it here. Mali spots the piece, colour, style and even sneaker models – and finds you similar pieces, new and second hand.
texts.Dein Foto wird nur kurz angeschaut und n: Your photo is only looked at briefly and never stored.
texts.Für deinen Kleiderschrank und dein Zuhau: For your wardrobe and your home
texts.Wir erkennen, ob ein Pin ein Outfit oder: We can tell whether a pin shows an outfit or a living room and keep the two apart. So your fashion style can be streetwear while your home style is Japandi.
texts.Oberteile, Hosen, Jacken, Kleider, Schuh: Tops, pants, jackets, dresses, shoes and accessories that match your outfit pins.
texts.Vasen, Leuchten, Kissen, Möbel und Pflan: Vases, lamps, cushions, furniture and plants. We recognise the objects in your pins.
Your pins decide what you see.
You sign in directly with Pinterest. We never see your password and can't change anything.
texts.Wähle die Boards, die dich zeigen. Darau: Choose the boards that feel like you. They become your style profiles for fashion and home.
texts.Stell dein Budget ein und sieh, was zu d: Set your budget and see what suits you. For every piece we tell you why.
texts.Gemacht für guten Geschmack und kleines: Made for great taste on a small budget
texts.Beige, oversized, Japandi? Wir lesen dei: Beige, oversized, Japandi? We read your style from your pins, not from a questionnaire.
texts.Outfit-Pins und Interior-Pins bekommen e: Outfit pins and interior pins get their own profiles, so suggestions really fit.
texts.Zeig nur, was du dir leisten willst. Bei: Only see what you want to spend. When two pieces fit equally well, the cheaper one comes first.
texts.Führt ein Pin zu Depop, Vinted oder Etsy: If a pin leads to Depop, Vinted or Etsy, we show you exactly that piece. Good for your wallet and the planet.
texts.Links, an denen wir verdienen, sind als: Links we earn from are marked as “Ad”. Your price stays the same.
texts.Nur Lesezugriff, keine Weitergabe, Verbi: Read-only access, no sharing, disconnect any time with one click.
texts.Auf Deutsch und Englisch, von „cozy“ bis: In English and German, from “cozy” to “Japandi”. “Cream knit” becomes beige – and Mali even recognises cuts like bootcut, wide leg or cropped.
texts.Wir nutzen nur, was wir für deine Vorsch: We only use what we need for your suggestions and never sell any of it.
texts.Nur Lesezugriff auf Konto, Boards und Pi: Read-only access to your account, boards and pins
texts.Kein Passwort, keine Cookies von Pintere: No password, no Pinterest cookies stored
texts.Verbindung jederzeit mit einem Klick tre: Disconnect any time with one click
texts.Dein Konto ist dein Pinterest-Login. Kei: Your account is your Pinterest login. No new password, no forms.
texts.Nein. Kaufst du über einen mit „Werbung“: No. If you buy through a link marked “Ad”, the shop pays us a small commission. Your price stays the same.
texts.Gegenstände für dein Zuhause: Deko wie V: Things for your home: decor like vases and candles, lighting, textiles like cushions and throws, kitchen & dining, furniture, plants and wall decor.
texts.Woher kommen die Produkte?: Where do the products come from?
texts.Von Shops und Marktplätzen wie eBay und: From shops and marketplaces like eBay and Etsy, and from your own pins when they lead to a shop or a second-hand listing.
texts.Brauche ich ein Pinterest-Business-Konto: Do I need a Pinterest business account?
texts.Nein, dein normales Pinterest-Konto reic: No, your regular Pinterest account is all you need.
texts.Kann ich ein Outfit per Foto finden?: Can I find an outfit from a photo?
texts.Ja. Lade einen Screenshot von TikTok, In: Yes. Upload a screenshot from TikTok, Instagram or Pinterest. Mali spots the piece, colour, style and well-known sneaker models and shows you similar pieces, new and second hand. The photo is never stored.
texts.Erkennt Malipin auch Schnitte wie Bootcu: Does Malipin recognise cuts like bootcut or wide leg?
texts.Ja. Malipin kennt rund 150 Merkmale wie: Yes. Malipin knows around 150 details like bootcut, wide leg, baggy, cropped, light wash, turtleneck, leather or corduroy and searches for exactly that – for example “baggy light wash jeans” instead of just “pants”.
texts.Gibt es auch Second Hand und Vintage?: Is there second hand and vintage too?
texts.Ja. Neben Neuware zeigt Malipin Second-H: Yes. Next to new items, Malipin shows second-hand and vintage listings, for example from eBay and Etsy. That way you often find your style cheaper and more sustainably.
texts.Shops und Verkäufer, die wir selbst gepr: Shops and sellers we have checked ourselves carry a “Verified shop” badge. On marketplaces from East Asia we filter out listings with brand names and typical fake words, so you don't end up with counterfeits.
texts.Ja. Unter „Mein Pinterest“ trennst du di: Yes. Under “My Pinterest” you can disconnect, and your stored access data is deleted. You can also revoke access in your Pinterest settings.
texts.Links mit der Kennzeichnung „Werbung“ si: Links labelled “Ad” are affiliate links. If you buy something through them, we receive a commission. Your price doesn't change.
